summary.text: Finley Warden is the Republican candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 2 Republican primary.
According to his campaign website, he has worked in Republican politics in Western Montana for the past four years.

paragraphs.text: Finley Warden describes himself on his campaign website as a sixth-generation Montanan from Polson, where his grandparents settled in the 1960s.

He states that he has spent four years working in Republican politics across Western Montana, including helping elect candidates and assisting with constituent services, and that he served as a citizen advocate during the last two legislative sessions.
His campaign site lists cutting taxes, reducing government spending and what he calls Montana values among his issues, and he cites property tax reform and parental rights among his goals.
